name: Tejwardhan
player_statement:
A complete player, Tejwardhan has made a big mark in cricket. With 12 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 58*, with an average of 26.43 and a quick strike rate of 149.19. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 22 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.2 overs, taking 6 wickets at an economy rate of 5.14. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
